name: Sandals
role: feet: a left and right pair of caligae
what_i_did: A left and right pair: bevelled sole plates, a cage of 5 strap arches over the foot, 3 long straps from toe to ankle, and a heel loop that rises behind the ankle.
good: Outline match 0.78: the thick soles, the lattice cage and the heel loops all read as the concept's caligae.
A true left and right, toes turned out a little, as the concept stands.
off: The concept's cage is denser and wraps further down the sides of the sole.
The heel loops are a little taller than the concept's.
The concept stands the pair side by side facing the camera; mine is staggered slightly, which costs some overlap in the score.
creative_additions: The heel loop, so the sandal reads as strapped on rather than a slipper.

rounds.t: First build: heel outline made a spike.
Heel arc reversed; cage arches and long straps tuned.

score.method: silhouette IoU after bounding-box normalising both masks; camera found by grid search on the model, so a guide
